content: Paulus yesa kal ngalir chol Ttey we ngo yesa sor bo, “Re wochilay re Israel! Ngang ila ye fel lal depey irel sangsengal yai memel doh mo fael metal Deus yee, la hola doh igla.”
Llulupal Temarong we Ananias idal yesa kangalur rechokwe re su lengchel bo rebe ppigri molwe yewal Paulus.

Paulus yesa kangalur bo, “Ye tugul le Deus yebe ppugrug, bo gel ila ho wochog pegil imw la ye bbech! Ho sala maro igla bo hobe hatugulu kofay le hobe dabey felel Hatobtob we, iwe ngo gel ho hatawsi Hatobtob we irel molwe ho kangalur bo rebe ppigriyey!”
Mal kowe re su lengchel Paulus resa kangalu bo, “Yesa tayikof yam hapatpat ngal Llulupal Temarong la yael Deus!”
Paulus yesa sor bo, “Re wochilay re Israel! Itugla le iye mele Llulupal Temarong. Babior we ye santus ye sor bo, ‘Ha towe ma hapatpat tayikof loh irel yami tamol.’”

Yodwe Paulus yela gola le rechokwe ila sibis ir Sadducees, ngo sibis ir Pharisees, ngo yesa malili long lal Ttey we le ye sor bo, “Re wochilay re Israel! Ngang ila semal Pharisees, ngo ngang ila layur Pharisees. Hasa hasiyeydoh iga bo habe hatugulu kofay le mil mala ye luglug depey le rechoka resa mes ila rebe chil molow tefael!”
Yodwe chog ye sor mele ngo sa chaep yar hachocho fengal Pharisees kowe mo Sadducees kowe, le resa harere chol ttey we.
(Sadducees kowe ila rema sor bo tor mele molow tefael mo irel maes, iwe ngo tor mele angelus mo ngoel; iwe ngo ir Pharisees kowe ila re chepar la rosuluw meka ngo yor.)

Yesa palengdah ttawul kowe yar. Iwe ngo sibis mokwe sensel Hatobtob we le ir chol rewe Pharisees resa sudah ngo resa paliliy mokwe ikowe sibis re sosor. Re hapallingi yalor le re sor bo: “Tor mele ye tayikof le ha gola le yeramtale ye foru! Malbo tos le semal yalus hare semal angelus mele ye maliliy ngali!”

Sa kkel loh yar hachocho fengal mo yar wahaha le tamol saldaw we yesa marherah bo rede mechigchigiloh Paulus. Iwe yesa kangalur saldaw kowe lol bo rebe loh irer chol ttey we bo re bela hasiy Paulus resa hasiloh lal yororol molwe bugter saldaw.
Lefhafel chog rallawe ngo Samol sa su mo lengchel Paulus ngo sa kangalu bo, “Ho towe motog! Hosa mel bo yai tugul mo wol Jerusalem le, be wol ila sengal mala ho bela foru mo wol Roma.”
Yar Mekada Bo Rebe Lliy Paulus

Yela lemaliyel rallawe seral ngo sibis Jews resa ttey fengal ngo resa kapta mele rebe foru ngal Paulus. Iwe resa rol hatugulu fengaliy le tor mele rebe mongoy hare re yulumi chal yee, yela wol miril yar limeseloh Paulus.
Yebe ligdi fayeg leper rechokla re kapta le rebe foru mele.
Iwe resa loh irel tamol temarong kowe mo mal kowe yar ngo re sala kangalur bo, “Hamem hasa rol hatugulu fengaliy le ha towe mongoy yee, la hola yodla habe limeseloh Paulus iyang.

Ila hami mo chol Ttey le habe fangloh yalomi irel tamol saldawel Roma we bo yebe fangdiy Paulus iremi. Habe kachapar bo habe hadogoyu bo hare habe gola tot kofal. Yodla ngo hamem ha bele faesul fel le habe limeseloh mo imol mala yebe hola doh iga.”
Iwe ngo tarmal we lol molwe mengal Paulus ye rongrong mokwe resa kapta. Yesa loh irel molwe bugter saldaw sala kangalu Paulus.
Paulus yesa fesangu semal tamol saldaw kowe sa kangalu bo, “Paliloh tarmal le irel tamol saldaw we yami; ye mel sew formel le ye bela kangalu.”

Iwe tamol pos we yesa fesangu sa palaloh irel tamol saldaw we ngo yesa kangalu bo, “Chol kalbus we Paulus ye fesanguyey ngo yesa kangaluyey bo ibe paladoh tarmal le irem bo ye mel sew formel le yebe kangalug.”
Tamol saldaw we sa holu molwe paol tarmal we sa paliloh ngo yesa kasiya bo, “Meda mele hobe kangaluyey?”

Ngo iy yesa sor bo, “Tamol Jews kowe resa kapta le walsu ngo resa dangroh hare hobe hasiloh Paulus irel Ttey we yar. Iwe ngo ir re bele la forurloh le chol Ttey la re dipli bo rebe hadogoyu Paulus bo hare rebe gola tot kofal.

Iwe ngo ho towe talenga mala rebe sor, bo be ligdi fayeg mal le rebe mwol le rebe wwedwed. Resa hatugulu fengaliy le tor mele rebe mongoy hare re yulumi chal yee, rela limeseloh Paulus. Igla ila resa fel le rebe foru mele ngo resa wedwed chog irel sew le hobe hatugulu.”
Tamol saldaw we yesa sor bo, “Tor le hobe kangalu bo hosa kangaluyey mele.” Iwe ngo yesa halho tarmal we.
Resa Fangloh Paulus Irel Tamol Aamwe Felix

Tamol saldaw we yesa fesangur rumal tamol saldaw kowe lol ngo yesa kangalur bo, “Hala hafler rubuguy saldaw bo rebe loh wol Caesarea, le ir mo fisig saldaw kowe rema dahdah wos, mo rubuguy saldaw kowe keey mele yar pitgil fedeg. Hala haliliy bo bela duwow klok bongey ngo hasa fel le habe loh.
Fang lol Paulus wos bo yebe dahdah iyang, iwe ngo hasa hafale irel yami hasiloh yee, yela hola Tamol Aamwe Felix.”
Iwe ngo Tamol saldaw we yar yesa tefa sew babior le iye sengal mekla ye mel iyang:
“Ngang Claudius Lysias ihabong ngalug gel Tamol Aamwe Felix: Ssarolwom.
Jews kowe re ddorfi yeramtale ila resa memeal le re bele limeseloh. Iwe ngo isa moch la gola le iy semal yarmetal Roma, iwe hasa loh mo saldaw ka layi ha sala hasi.
Imemeal le ibe gola fael mele re luluwaley le rebe limeseloh iyang, iwe isa hasiloh irel Ttey la yar.
Isa moch la gola le tor sew formel le ye foru le be yor fal le yebe mes hare ye kalbus iyang. Mekla re sor bo yesa hadre, ila kofal chog yar hatobtob ir lufulyer.
Iwe ngo ila rongrong le resa kapta bo re bele limeseloh, iwe ngo isa hafengawey irem. Isa kangalur rechokla re ssong ngali bo rebe hasi song kala yar resa hasiwey irem bo rebe kangalug.”
Saldaw kowe re foru molwe ye kangalur. Re hasi Paulus llubungul rallawe resa hasiloh yee, rela hola Antipatris.
Yela rallawe seral ngo saldaw kowe resa darloh chog resa tefael ngal molwe bugter saldaw, ngo ikowe sibis we re dahdah wos resa dabey Paulus.
Re hasiloh Paulus woal Caesarea, re sala fang babior we ngal Tamol Aam we ngo re wol fang Paulus ngali.
Tamol Aam we ye yawli babior we ngo yesa kasiya Paulus hare iy semal chol fulufa. Molwe yela gola le ye budoh Paulus mo woal Cilicia,
ngo yesa sor bo, “Rebe rel budoh rechokla re ssong ngalug ngo siya moch rol tettal hapatpat.” Iwe ngo yesa sor bo rebe posa chog Paulus mo lal imw we imwel Tamol Aam.
